instruction: Set GIMP's icon theme to 'Color' to use colorful icons instead of symbolic ones.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing GIMP's icon theme to 'Color' via Edit > Preferences > Icon Theme. The evaluator checks gimprc config file for 'icon-theme "Color"' entry. Similar difficulty to original theme change task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly extracts GIMP config file (gimprc) from the appropriate path (~/.config/GIMP/2.10/gimprc)
Metric check_config_status correctly parses GIMP's S-expression config format and checks for key-value pairs
Expected value '"Color"' (with quotes) is semantically correct - GIMP stores string values with quotes in gimprc
Postconfig appropriately closes GIMP (Ctrl+Q) to ensure settings are written to disk before verification
Complete coverage: instruction only requires setting icon theme to 'Color', and evaluator checks exactly that
No edge case issues: getter handles file not found, metric handles empty/malformed config
